chunks: 980 - ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿUtbah narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, who said:

"Whoever says ten times before the sun rises and before its setting: 'There is no god but Allah, alone, having no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things'—it shall be an expiation for his sins on that day."

key_terms.الْحَمْدُ: All praise and gratitude belong to Allah.
key_terms.الْمُلْكُ: Sovereign dominion and kingship belonging solely to Allah.
key_terms.ذُنُوبِهِ: The person's sins committed in that day.
key_terms.قَدِيرٌ: Possessing complete power over all things.
key_terms.كَفَّارَةً: A means of expiation for sins.
key_terms.لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: The declaration of tawhid: there is no god but Allah.
key_terms.لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ: Affirmation that Allah has no partner or associate.
key_terms.يُحْيِي وَ يُمِيتُ: Allah alone gives life and causes death.

ai.seo_question: What dhikr should be recited before sunrise and sunset for forgiveness of sins?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a morning and evening dhikr centered on tawhid and the divine attributes of Allah. Reciting it ten times before sunrise and before sunset is described as an expiation for the sins committed during that day.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.980 - Abdul Karim ibn Utbah narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:

"Whoever says ten times before sunrise and ten times before sunset,
'There is no god but Allah (swt), alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is alive and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things,'
it will be an expiation for their sins on that day."
